facts.function: generates and dispenses chlorine in spa water

gri_path: GRI 1: candidates 8543.30 (electrolysis apparatus), 8421.21 (water filtering/purifying machinery), 3824/2828 (chemical preparation) depending on what the cartridge is

rejected_alternatives.reason: test strips (R01295), not a chlorine generator
pool accessories heading only if no more specific machinery heading applies

missing_facts: Is the cartridge an electrolytic cell with electrodes (electrical apparatus) or a cartridge of salt or chemical compound consumed in use?
Does it have electrical components or power supply, and does it filter/purify or only generate chlorine?
classification.rationale: An electrolytic chlorine-generating cell would go to 8543.30 (cf. N016501 electrolysis pitcher) or 8421.21, whereas a chemical cartridge is a chapter 28/38 good; the description does not say which.
